fresh_conditions.notes: Rated head motor: XL330-M288. 5 V is an evaluation hypothesis, not measured bus voltage. 80% torque/PWM and command rate/acceleration caps are software design choices, not continuous ratings or firmware settings. Inertia/friction/PID mapping/mass placement remain unidentified. Legacy PD fields apply only during artificial reset; datasheet-bounded torque control replaces them before rollout. Speed-first software target profile: sharp_targets; physical torque/mass/contact bounds unchanged. This is not an identified firmware profile.
